name: 水感细雾保湿喷雾款
description: 细密水雾快速补水、随身便携随时保湿、清爽不黏腻

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshot and trust shots, soft sakura-pink gradient #F6D9D0 to #FBEBE6 for benefit, pain, scene and infographic shots
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting with a gentle top-front key, soft diffused shadows and delicate water highlights; airy water-and-mist mood
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte light-stone counter #E7E0DA and neutral matte board #EFE5E0
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines in charcoal #33383D, all copy wrapped in 「」; coral #E86248 reserved for accent labels, small round badges and thin-line icons, not for body text
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons and small round badges, single coral accent color #E86248
styleLock.presentationRules: upright spray can, stable slight 3/4 hero scale and placement across the set, every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh hydrating skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white background #FFFFFF, soft sakura-pink #F6D9D0, charcoal text #33383D and one coral accent #E86248; bright soft studio lighting with a gentle top-front key, soft diffused shadows and delicate water highlights, an airy water-and-mist mood; modern geometric sans-serif headlines in #33383D with all copy wrapped in 「」; consistent rounded info labels, small round badges and thin-line icons; clean high-end skincare photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable upright product scale and placement; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level at a slight 3/4 angle, upright can, full product visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front key with soft fill, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The upright spray can shown at a slight 3/4 angle, straight-on eye-level, full product visible. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front key and soft fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the product. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 35-40% of the frame centered on the vertical axis, and the even white field closes the composition so the frame reads as one complete clean packshot. 8K, commercial beauty e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no decorative elements, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 用飞溅水环放大补水的第一卖点，一秒说清核心利益
shots.camera: low angle looking slightly upward, can centered inside a circular water ripple and splash ring
shots.lighting: soft top-front key light, delicate highlights on the water ring, fine droplets frozen in air
shots.props: a circular water ripple and splash ring with fine droplets
shots.textZone: top area headline 「{callout_1}」 in #33383D with three small round badges 「{selling_point_1}」 「{selling_point_2}」 「{selling_point_3}」 in #E86248 below it
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a low angle looking slightly upward, the can centered inside a clean circular water ripple and splash ring with fine droplets frozen in air, filling 50-60% of the frame. Background soft sakura-pink gradient #F6D9D0 blending to #FBEBE6. Soft top-front key light with delicate highlights on the water ring. The top area carries a headline 「{callout_1}」 in #33383D with three small round badges 「{selling_point_1}」 「{selling_point_2}」 「{selling_point_3}」 in #E86248 below it, balanced against the splash ring so the frame reads as one complete composition. Negative: no invented efficacy claims, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no brand marks, no cut-off splash.

shots.intent: 放大干燥、紧绷、缺水的肌肤痛点，引出喷雾的即时缓解
shots.camera: matched split-screen framing, identical macro camera on both panels
shots.lighting: left panel slightly harsh flat light conveying dryness; right panel soft gentle light
shots.textZone: one short label per panel 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #33383D
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen of {product}, two matched panels with identical camera and framing. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Left panel: an abstract macro of tight, dull, flaking dehydrated skin texture conveying dryness, no real face, under slightly harsh flat light. Right panel: {product} misting a fine cloud of water droplets in soft gentle light. Background soft sakura-pink #F6D9D0 on both panels. One short label per panel 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #33383D. The product occupies 50-60% of its panel, and the matched panel edges and thin center divider close the layout so the frame reads as one finished split composition. Negative: no real model face, no fabricated statistics or claims, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 代入日常随身补水的真实场景，营造清爽晨间氛围
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down over a vanity counter, candid feel
shots.lighting: soft morning window light from the left, 5500K, gentle mist in the air, soft contact shadow
shots.props: a folded towel and a small ceramic tray, not covering the product
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene of {product} on a light stone vanity counter #E7E0DA. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down at the counter with the can standing among a folded towel and a small ceramic tray, props not covering the product, the product occupying 40-50% of the frame. Soft morning window light from the left, 5500K, gentle mist in the air, soft contact shadow. The counter texture and the towel and tray fill the rest of the frame, so the scene reads as one complete morning composition with natural breathing margins. Negative: no visible face, no hands covering the product, no messy clutter, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用雾化瞬间的微距证明雾够细、够均匀
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro from a clean 90-degree side profile, shallow depth of field, foreground droplets sharp
shots.lighting: soft backlight from behind the mist making the droplets glow, gentle front fill
shots.whitespace: minimal, detail is the whole point
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the nozzle spraying a fine even mist cloud frozen mid-air. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a clean 90-degree side profile with shallow depth of field, foreground droplets sharp. Soft backlight from behind the mist making the droplets glow, gentle fill from the front. Neutral matte board background #EFE5E0. The mist and nozzle detail fills 55-60% of the frame, minimal whitespace, the detail is the whole point. Negative: no blurry subject, no oversized droplets, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no hands.

shots.intent: 把使用方法拆成三步信息图，消除怎么用的疑虑
shots.camera: flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, can upright
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow
shots.props: three numbered rounded step cards with thin-line icons
shots.textZone: three numbered rounded cards in a row, each with one short step label 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」 in #33383D and a thin-line icon in #E86248
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic layout for {product}, flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle with the can upright. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow. Background soft sakura-pink #F6D9D0. Three numbered rounded cards in a row, each carrying one short step label 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」 in #33383D and a thin-line icon in #E86248; the upright can stands beside the card row so the product anchors the layout. The product and card row together occupy 60-70% of the frame, with even sakura-pink margins closing the composition. Negative: no tiny unreadable text, no dense body text, no invented usage claims, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 以喷头工艺与细腻雾感特写背书温和配方，降低购买顾虑

shots.lighting: even clean studio light, soft contact shadow
shots.props: one large rounded panel holding a macro of the spray nozzle's fine aperture and a delicate mist-texture swatch
shots.textZone: one headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #33383D above the panel; two short trust labels 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #33383D inside the panel
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The can shown straight-on at eye level on the left, with one large rounded panel on the right holding a close-up macro of the spray nozzle's fine machined aperture and a small delicate mist-texture swatch in soft sakura-pink #F6D9D0, so the panel reads as tangible product craft rather than empty surface. Background pure white #FFFFFF, even clean studio light with a soft contact shadow. One headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #33383D sits above the panel, and two short trust labels 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 in #33383D sit inside the panel. The product and panel together occupy 50-60% of the frame, composed as one complete balanced layout. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, awards, ratings or test data, no fabricated badges or seals, no watermark, no fake logo, no QR code.

shots.intent: 以双支组合收口促单，优惠主张直接入图引导行动
shots.camera: slight 3/4 group view, two units side by side to suggest a set
shots.lighting: even soft studio light, soft contact shadows
shots.background: coral accent band #E86248 across the lower third, clean sakura-pink #F6D9D0 above
shots.textZone: a short CTA line 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF on the coral band and one short offer line 「{selling_point_1}」 in #33383D on a rounded white tag above the band
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce closing CTA shot of {product}, a slight 3/4 group view with a second unit beside it to suggest a set. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even soft studio light with soft contact shadows. Background coral accent band #E86248 across the lower third with clean sakura-pink #F6D9D0 above. A short CTA line 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF sits on the coral band, and one short offer line 「{selling_point_1}」 in #33383D sits on a rounded white tag just above the band, completing one finished promotional composition. The group occupies 65-75% of the frame with tight even margins. Negative: no real discount numbers, no invented offers, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text.

provenance.notes: 从 6 张爆款补水喷雾详情长图切片提炼；已剥离源图中的多个品牌字样与 logo、模特面部、二维码、原文案及不可验证的数据话术（如虚构百分比）；旧版信任镜的空徽章占位改为喷头工艺与雾感特写的可验证呈现；产品一律以 {product} 占位，可复用于任意补水保湿喷雾。
